**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, including other sync tools.

**Does this belong in the extension or the backend?**
Some features need server-side changes (migrations, edge functions) — if you have a hunch, say so.

**Additional context**
Screenshots or mockups welcome.
